(5) Mudsdale: Body Press 4x SE ~56% to Kingambit from full — never leave Kingambit in without Tailwind/kill plan; EQ OHKOs Gengar; Stamina+Shell Bell survives unboosted double-ups (EBall ~44% per hit, special ignores Def boosts); Gyarados is the answer (EQ-immune, resists Body Press, Waterfall 2x SE, always outspeeds even without Tailwind: 133 vs max 87); Whimsicott Energy Ball 2x SE. (6) Rotom WoW threatens physical attackers — answer with Gengar special pressure. (7) Supreme Overlord locks at switch-in — prefer Kingambit late after faints. (8) Corviknight Body Press 4x SE Kingambit — break with Gyarados Ice Fang / Gengar chip, deny Roost. (9) Blaziken benched unless Corviknight central. (10) Tendencies: protects/preserves wincons; Protects to stall my Tailwind (Mudsdale too); priority to pick off low-HP targets. (11) KEY: Prankster Encore punishes their Protect-stalling — locks last move so Protect fails; use to close out games vs Protect users. (12) Game 2 they brought Gholdengo

decisions.rationale: Gholdengo is fainted and can only pass. Mudsdale cannot KO either foe in one hit and will be outsped and OHKO'd by Whimsicott's Energy Ball before acting. Rock Slide is the best offensive option — it can chip Gyarados (2× weak) and rolls a 10% flinch chance, but no realistic win path exists from this 1v2 at 27% HP.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 loss: Prankster Tailwind + fast offense overwhelmed. Whimsicott Timid max Spe FocusSash, Gengar Modest LO, Kingambit Adamant BlackGlasses, Gyarados Intimidate pivot, Blazikenite SD setup. Mudsdale Body Press 4× OHKOs Kingambit from full. In future series: lead Azumarill early vs Kingambit/Blaziken; consider Trick Room Farigiraf to reverse speed. Gholdengo Life Orb Make It Rain breaks Whimsicott Sash. Revealed: Whimsicott carried Energy Ball (not just Moonblast), Gyarados WacanBerry, Mudsdale Careful with heavy SpD/HP investment.

reflections.summary: Won on team-preview matchup: Whimsicott/Kingambit/Gyarados had a clean answer to all four opposing threats. The turn-4 double KO (Energy Ball into Azumarill, Kowtow into Farigiraf) removed their only speed control before Trick Room went up, and from there Gyarados plus Prankster Encore closed out Mudsdale. Only blemish: Kingambit was traded away into Mudsdale — the Stamina+Shell Bell double-up failure the notes already warned about happened exactly as predicted (survived at 21%, healed, KO'd bac
reflections.adjustment: Stop double-upping Kingambit into Mudsdale: pivot straight to Gyarados (Intimidate, EQ-immune, resists Body Press, always outspeeds) and let Whimsicott chip with Energy Ball alongside it, keeping Kingambit healthy for a late Supreme Overlord endgame. For game 3, expect them to re-add Corviknight to wall Gengar and 4x-SE Kingambit — if Corviknight looks central at preview, swap Gengar for Blaziken; otherwise the same four are validated.

reflections.summary: Lost the lead matchup badly. Our lead of Azumarill and Farigiraf was both weak to the opponent's lead Whimsicott (Energy Ball) and Kingambit (Kowtow Cleave); both were KO'd before acting. This left us with only Mudsdale and Gholdengo, and Gholdengo was soon crit OHKO'd by Kingambit. Mudsdale fought back, KO'd Kingambit, but was then worn down by repeated Energy Ball, Waterfall, and Intimidate, and finally Encored and KO'd by Gyarados. The fundamental issue was a poor team-preview lead selection
reflections.adjustment: Next game, lead with Mudsdale and Farigiraf, and give Farigiraf a Focus Sash (instead of Sitrus Berry) to guarantee Trick Room set-up. Turn 1: Farigiraf uses Trick Room (its Armor Tail blocks Whimsicott's Prankster Encore), Mudsdale Protects or attacks. This reverses the speed advantage, allows Mudsdale to OHKO Kingambit with Body Press, and lets Gholdengo clean up. Avoid leading Azumarill or Gholdengo into Whimsicott+Kingambit.
reflections.notebook: Opponent preferred Whimsicott+Kingambit lead (game 2). Whimsicott Timid, Focus Sash, Prankster, has Energy Ball and Encore in addition to Moonblast/Tailwind. Kingambit Adamant, BlackGlasses, Kowtow Cleave. Gyarados Intimidate pivot, Wacan Berry, Waterfall/Ice Fang/Thunder Wave. Gengar Modest Life Orb, Taunt. Mudsdale Body Press is a reliable Kingambit answer (4× OHKO); unaffected by Intimidate. Farigiraf's Armor Tail blocks priority (including Encore). Future plan: use Farigiraf with Focus Sash to set Trick Room reliably; lead Mudsdale+Farigiraf; under Trick Room, Mudsdale outspeeds and KO's Kingambit, Gholdengo breaks Whimsicott's Sash with Make It Rain. Avoid bringing Azumarill or Gholdengo into that lead.
